digest.component_or_area: Anthropic provider test doubles and lazy import
propositions: Test patches replaced anthropic.AsyncAnthropic with function objects before pydantic_ai.providers.anthropic was imported, causing lazy-import evaluation of the TypeAlias union to raise TypeError.
The defect is test isolation (improper test-double representation), not a production secret-redaction or auth-validation flaw; production validation correctly occurs before client construction.

Three function-shaped patches in test_rp04_s4_llm_runtime_heldout.py at lines 41, 60, and 125 must be replaced with class-shaped doubles that preserve the SDK symbol contract and constructor fail-fast tripwires.

An in-process oracle was added (test_anthropic_lazy_import_isolation_heldout.py) that forces fresh provider-absent interpreters and asserts the redacted LLMConfigError is reached, observed RED before fix and GREEN after fix.
